time_support: partition window boundaries; all covering windows must meet Music and RMS; any vocal risk window vetoes admission
hard_unknown: any window Music<0.2 or RMS<0.0001; edge allowance never makes silence music
selection: calibration negatives must all remain unadmitted; calibration positives >=5/6 and >=1 per positive layer; prefer stricter Music, coverage and gap, no transition exception where tied; evaluate only one selected rule on holdout
holdout_gate: negative zero admissions including short-voice mixtures; positive >=5/6 and >=1 per positive layer; no retuning on holdout
